rows.name: BlockTube
rows.reason: BlockTube blocks channels/titles while retaining playlists/autoplay; untested. Browser unspecified; Firefox/Chrome documented. Uploader/title rules cannot identify unlabelled original producers. Current README/options undated; Firefox 0.4.8 predates question.

rows.name: MusicBrainz Picard
rows.reason: It tags and organizes local music files; the documented features do not filter YouTube channels, recommendations, or autoplay.

rows.name: Channel Blocker
rows.reason: Channel Blocker filters channels/regex, but autoplay skip-versus-hide behavior is unverified. Version 3.0.5's 2024-08-04 update does not imply abandonment or non-support. No browser runtime test occurred.

rows.name: YouTube Autoplay switch set to Off
rows.reason: Disables next related-video playback if stopping all such autoplay is acceptable. Settings vary by device; not established to cancel every playlist/Mix continuation or provide a general playlist block.

rows.name: Channel Blocker
rows.reason: Channel blacklist and regex remove ARTE-associated YouTube videos. Primary listing does not establish dependable autoplay interception; test that behavior before relying on unattended listening.

rows.name: Language & Keyword Filter for YouTube
rows.reason: The Firefox YouTube filter matches ARTE in channels/titles. Text can miss unlabelled reuploads or overmatch; playback interception is not promised, and current version postdates cutoff.

rows.name: YTBlock
rows.reason: Channel/title/regex filtering; autoplay behavior and June 2026 availability unverified. Listing v6.3.1 updated 2026-11-19; some metadata needs Google API key, unused here. Additional lead only.

rows.name: BlockTube
rows.reason: Its channel blacklist and playback filtering can exclude ARTE uploaders while keeping other YouTube videos; block every relevant channel and verify current browser behavior.

rows.name: Pi-hole standalone DNS blocker
rows.reason: Standalone DNS blocking distinguishes domains, not YouTube channels; the supplied support thread offers blocking all YouTube, which violates the requirement to retain other videos.

rows.name: BlockTube
rows.reason: Video/channel/regex blocking documents autoplay preservation and advancement. Configure ARTE identities/optional title rules, leaving YouTube available. Unidentified reuploads and live browser compatibility remain untested.

rows.name: BlockTube
rows.reason: Stable ARTE channel-ID rules exclude selected uploaders while retaining other YouTube playback. Cover every relevant uploader; unrelated-channel reuploads need additional rules. Current YouTube compatibility untested.

rows.name: YouTube Autoplay switch
rows.reason: Disabling YouTube Autoplay prevents automatic related-video continuation across all channels. It does not remove ARTE search/recommendation results; inspected help does not establish playlist behavior.

rows.name: Pi-hole standalone DNS blocker
rows.reason: Standalone DNS rules select domains, not channel paths. All-YouTube blocking violates exclusion; allowing shared domains does not filter ARTE. This does not claim every Pi-hole configuration blocks YouTube.

rows.name: MusicBrainz Picard
rows.reason: Audio matching, tagging, renaming and folder organization do not intercept YouTube channel recommendations or autoplay. Whole-solution operating-surface mismatch is established independently of the hard exclusion.
